<thought>Based on the 13C NMR data, peaks in the typical aromatic carbon region (≈110–160 ppm) are: 142.60, 133.69, 133.25, 132.62, 130.15 (twice), 129.32, 128.37, 128.16, 127.72, 127.15 (twice), 126.45, 125.88, 125.73, and 125.50 ppm. This gives a total of 15 aromatic carbon signals (counting the duplicated peaks as separate carbons). Therefore, the compound contains 15 aromatic carbon atoms.</thought>
<final_answer>15</final_answer>
